title: App Template
summary: The starting point of a native full-screen app: every shared widget, the on-screen keyboard rule, a background command.
description: A template for developers, not an app for users (it is a draft: never published). A native full-screen app on the launcher's cp0_lvgl: the page header with the shared status strip and the on-screen Esc, a roller with Nav, Toggle, Info and Busy rows, an info table, a text field with the app's own on-screen keyboard (shown only when no physical keyboard is connected, the launcher's rule), a dialog and a background command whose lines arrive live. Everything is laid out from the launcher's design tokens, so it fits 640x480, 800x480, 720x720 and 1280x720. Needs a screen of at least 640x480 and a launcher with full-screen app support.
